statusLine.command: bash -c 'json=$(cat); model=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".model.display_name"); cost=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".cost.total_cost_usd" | awk "{printf \"%.2f\", \$1}"); ctx=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".context_window.used_percentage"); ctx_size=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".context_window.context_window_size / 1000 | floor | tostring + \"k\""); cwd=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".cwd"); project_dir=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".workspace.project_dir"); project_name=$(basename "$project_dir"); if [ "$cwd" = "$project_dir" ]; then rel="$project_name"; else rel="$project_name/${cwd#$project_dir/}"; fi; branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); ESC=$(printf "\033"); agent=$(echo "$json" | jq -r ".agent.name // \"default\""); project_emoji_file="$project_dir/.claude/agent-emojis.json"; global_emoji_file="$HOME/.claude/agent-emojis.json"; if [ -f "$project_emoji_file" ]; then emoji_file="$project_emoji_file"; elif [ -f "$global_emoji_file" ]; then emoji_file="$global_emoji_file"; else emoji_file=""; fi; if [ -n "$emoji_file" ]; then icon=$(jq -r --arg a "$agent" ".[\$a] // \"🤖\"" "$emoji_file"); else icon="🤖"; fi; if [ -n "$branch" ]; then loc="${ESC}[94m${rel}${ESC}[0m ${ESC}[36m(${branch})${ESC}[0m"; else loc="${ESC}[94m${rel}${ESC}[0m"; fi; printf "${ESC}[38;5;225m%s${ESC}[0m ${ESC}[2m|${ESC}[0m %s ${ESC}[2m|${ESC}[0m ${ESC}[38;5;222mctx: %s%% (%s)${ESC}[0m ${ESC}[2m|${ESC}[0m ${ESC}[38;5;217m\$%s${ESC}[0m ${ESC}[2m|${ESC}[0m %s ${ESC}[97m%s${ESC}[0m\n" "$model" "$loc" "$ctx" "$ctx_size" "$cost" "$icon" "$agent"'
